issues.title: Orders tab not showing message edited by current user
issues.body:
The "do not lose form data" logic in `PlanningMessagesList` isn't quite right.

I am logged in as "MTG-2".  If I edit one of my orders documents, and save it, the updated document is shown.

But, if I open one of my documents for edit, then "MTG-1" edits and saves one of their documents, then when I save mine, the new version isn't shown.  The form has been sent, since when I refresh I see the modified version.

It _looks like_ we need to clear the `messageBeingEdited` flag before we send the postback.  Or we do `postback` in a `timeout()`, to let `messageBeingEdited` state update to false before we receive the new document(s) from the backend.

Note: I tried both of the above strategies, but neither worked. I _think_ the issue is the `editorValue` method is saying a document is being edited when one isn't.  It is setting the flag to true when the UI updates after `postback` in `saveMessage`.

Hmm, the issue actually goes away when the user collapses the detail panel.  Can we programatically close the detail panel when the player clicks on `Save`?
